plan.name: Check all storage and cooking areas systematically
plan.strategy: Systematically check all storage and cooking areas for a pan, ensuring no location is missed before cleaning and placing it on the countertop.
steps: Search cabinets 1 to 6, drawers 1 to 3, and shelves 1 to 3 for a pan.
If not found, check the stoveburners 1 to 4, microwave 1, toaster 1, and fridge 1.
If a pan is located, take it to the sinkbasin 1 and clean it.
Place the cleaned pan on one of the countertops (1, 2, or 3).
